about: Volter Editor's ambientCG asset browser and import as they ship (volter-ai/editor b86dde8c5618, packages/editor-core/server/asset-library-routes.ts, types removed): its own fetch, no SDK and no key (ambientCG's API is public), searches the materials for wood, shows the preview image the search names, reads Wood 096's files by searching its id as a fresh server does, downloads its 1K-PNG zip (following the download link's redirect) and extracts it with unzip as the editor does, asserting the maps. The catalog holds only what is published to it, so the app publishes Wood 096 first through the World's publisher door.

files..env.example: # ambientCG's API is public: the editor sends no key

retention.none: The editor only reads ambientCG's public catalog and downloads its files: it stores nothing at ambientCG, holds no account or key there, and its import lands on its own disk, so there is no vendor record of the app's to read back.
